highlights.title: New ShadLingo light and dark themes
highlights.description: For a different reading atmosphere, choose white surfaces with deep blue text, or a dark theme with deep blue surfaces.

highlights.title: Pure white and deep blue reading paper
highlights.description: Choose pure white or deep blue paper for web articles and ebooks. PDFs keep their original page colors in dark mode.

highlights.title: Compare theme and paper samples
highlights.description: Options show library and reader samples to compare text and backgrounds. Switching light or dark categories correctly restores the theme and paper remembered for that category.

highlights.title: Fixed PDF loading failures
highlights.description: Fixed URL resolution when loading the PDF engine in a Worker, and added a loading indicator while the document is being prepared.
